input.sql: select FLX_ANN_MOI, count(*), sum(PRS_REM_MNT), sum(FLT_REM_MNT) from FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS group by 1 order by 1

input.final_sql:
select d.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB, sum(f.PRS_REM_MNT) as amount
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f
join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET d on f.AGE_BEN_SNDS = d.AGE_BEN_SNDS
where f.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501 and f.AGE_BEN_SNDS <> 99
group by d.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB, d.AGE_BEN_SNDS
order by d.AGE_BEN_SNDS

final_sql:
select d.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB, sum(f.PRS_REM_MNT) as amount
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f
join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET d on f.AGE_BEN_SNDS = d.AGE_BEN_SNDS
where f.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501 and f.AGE_BEN_SNDS <> 99
group by d.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB, d.AGE_BEN_SNDS
order by d.AGE_BEN_SNDS
